title: Iman Houssien - Their Eyes
htmlContent:
Iman Houssien drops a new track called "Their Eyes". The words to describe how good this record is, are truly limitless with everything being truly supreme about this special tune. The production is filled with appeal and engulfs the listener in the waves of the music, with a vocal approach that has a perfect blend of finesse and bravado to it, that is super infectious and makes you buy in completely.

Iman Houssien's "Their Eyes" is truly an amazing record that continues to give us all a reason, to enjoy new music. Everything about this record brilliance from the production, writing, and vocals it’s something you don’t want to miss out on, and enjoy to the fullest.
